Command and Scripting Interpreter

ID: T1059
Adversaries may abuse command and script interpreters to execute commands, scripts, or binaries. These interfaces and languages provide ways of interacting with computer systems and are a common feature across many different platforms.

Procedure Examples

IDNameDescription
G0007 APT28 APT28 has used a variety of public exploits combined with shell command execution to achieve persistence.
G0016 APT29 APT29 has used PowerShell to execute commands and scripts.

Mitigations

IDMitigationDescription
M1038 Execution Prevention Use application control where appropriate.
M1042 Disable or Remove Feature or Program Disable or remove any unnecessary or unused shells or interpreters.

Detection Strategy

Monitor command-line arguments for suspicious activity. Look for processes whose execution may be related to malicious activity, such as cmd.exe or powershell.exe with anomalous parent processes.
